# CodeArena

CodeArena is a developer community for practicing coding and prompting, competing in real-time human battles, and creating coding games.

## Core experiences

- Coding and SQL practice: https://codearena.co/practice
- Prompt practice: https://codearena.co/practice?mode=prompting
- Human coding and prompt battles: https://codearena.co/matchmaking
- Problem library: https://codearena.co/problems
- Human tournaments: https://codearena.co/tournaments
- Rankings: https://codearena.co/players
- CreatorArena: https://codearena.co/create
- Community gallery: https://codearena.co/gallery

CodeArena also supports friend challenges, rematches, profiles, messages, presence, notifications, and battle history.

Support: support@codearena.co
